decision: Kiem tu cach o lop chung, chan mac dinh: AuthMiddleware doi nghia thanh co phien VA la thanh vien; loai phuong an gan MemberMiddleware tung router va phuong an assertMember trong tung service theo mau Zalo

decision: Chua duong doc tu cach bang SignedInMiddleware co ten gan rieng cho workspace.get, chuyen AuthMiddleware cua router workspace xuong muc thu tuc; loai phuong an danh sach duong dan mien tru trong middleware

decision: Khong tat hay rut ngan bo dem phien; cua tab dang mo dong bang kiem tu cach tuoi o moi loi goi

decision: Doi bai cqt-access cua ho so da ky chi-quan-tri-sua-duoc-truong: nguoi ngoai kho goi fields.access nay nhan 403 tu cach thay vi 200 canManage false; va cqt-member-bi-chan doi thong diep cua hang non-member sang thong diep tu cach

decision: Bai ghi-ke-hoach-json (noi-bon-nut) gieo nguoi thanh thanh vien truoc khi mint phien; bai cu xanh chi vi API chua hoi tu cach
